'''Fentis Brach''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] Sith of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fentis Brach appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Sith Inquisitor gear vendor on Imperial Fleet.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
